effects.printed_clause: If the opponent controls a card, activate this Trap from hand.
effects.lua_implementation: EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_HAND condition checks any opponent on-field card.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Dominus hand-activation permission while the opponent controls a card.

effects.printed_clause: When an effect targets a card you own: negate that effect, then if a Trap is in your GY destroy that card.
effects.lua_implementation: Activation condition inspects CHAININFO_TARGET_CARDS by owner; resolution NegateEffect then conditionally destroys the chain event card if a Trap remains in own GY.

effects.printed_clause: If activated from hand, cannot activate NATURE, ELECTRIC, METAL or ICE monster effects for the rest of the Duel. Only 1 activation per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Captures STATUS_ACT_FROM_HAND, registers a no-reset CANNOT_ACTIVATE field effect for the four custom attribute bits, and uses an oath activation count.

official_references.matched_structure: No-reset rest-of-Duel monster-attribute activation lock after hand activation and oath activation limit.

coverage_override.reason: The hand-activation permission, negate/conditional-destroy activation, and persistent post-hand-activation Attribute lock are the three distinct audit units; the activation HOPT is covered with those linked activation semantics.
